description: This file defines the ActivationWorkingSet class, which manages a set of recently active grain activations within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for tracking activation lifecycle events, monitoring idle members, and notifying observers. It also implements lifecycle participation for integration with the silo lifecycle.

classes.name: ActivationWorkingSet
classes.description: Manages a list of recently active activations, tracks their state, and notifies observers. Implements lifecycle participation to monitor and update the working set periodically.

classes.name: IActivationWorkingSet
classes.description: Interface for managing the set of recently active grain activations.

classes.name: IActivationWorkingSetMember
classes.description: Represents an activation within the working set, with a method to determine if it is a candidate for removal.

classes.name: IActivationWorkingSetObserver
classes.description: Interface for observers that react to changes in the working set, such as additions, removals, and state changes.

methods.name: ActivationWorkingSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the working set with dependencies and observers.

methods.name: OnActivated
methods.description: Adds a new activation member to the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnActive
methods.description: Marks an existing member as active and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnEvicted
methods.description: Removes a member from the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Handles deactivation initiation for a member.

methods.name: OnDeactivated
methods.description: Handles completion of deactivation for a member.

methods.name: MonitorWorkingSet
methods.description: Periodically scans the working set to identify idle members for eviction.

methods.name: VisitMember
methods.description: Evaluates a member's state to determine if it should be evicted or marked idle.

methods.name: LogExceptionVisitingWorkingSetMember
methods.description: Logs exceptions encountered during working set member visits.
